command_reproduction_scope.bf16_unused_quantized_execution_override: Dense BF16 retains its captured bnb configuration default; it does not execute quantized linear kernels.
command_reproduction_scope.input_requirement: The pinned base model, data split and processor contract identities remain required; private paths and templates are omitted. The exact package-relative command specifications describe the historical measured build, not support for fresh combined training in the current build.
command_reproduction_scope.ordering: python, then launcher_arguments, --config, config, override_separator, then overrides in their recorded order.

correctness_scope.inherited_own_four_prerequisites: NF completed15 allocated checks; BF retained FAILED14 allocated checks plus a separate exact CPU reload comparison. This study does not relabel that BF allocation as completed.

data_scope.scoring_source: Exposed training-calibration64; not independent development or final-test data.

limitations: Two same-seed timing repeats per role, not independent seeds or confidence intervals. Ordinary NF versus optimized NF measures the combined execution/head change; optimized BF is a separate resource/runtime reference.

Node/NUMA, shared filesystem/page cache, startup and system load are not isolated. Steps6-20 remain inside warmup30, not steady-state300 throughput. Initial validation precedes the step1 timer; initial and final validation are included in native training-command wall time and reported separately.
Worker preparation durations overlap waits/execution and are not additive wall-time components. Nested command/phase timers are not additional allocation cost.

Score64 is exposed training calibration, not a quality or noninferiority gate. Its observed geometry is not a census of all160 training rows. Historical failed quality guards and fresh independent-data blocker remain unchanged.
Device/process/host peaks are sampled lower bounds with retained coverage gaps. Allocator events cover stated intervals only; whole-host physical/cgroup peak is unknown.

Own-four recovery prerequisites remain separately scoped, including BF FAILED14 plus the CPU comparison supplement. No new20 interruption recovery or cross-head exact trajectory/payload equivalence is claimed. No automatic release, small-GPU, inference or external-stack equivalence claim.

Configured8 video frames, observed pixel_values_videos shape960x1536, and video_grid_thw shape1x3 do not prove distinct source frames or actual grid values; training geometry outside scored64 remains unknown.
All six full allocations and original pair ratios are retained. The second pair differs in GPU and CPU/NUMA placement; the two-pair aggregate is not a causal speed estimate.

Inspection/export allocator peaks are not separately measured by this reducer. Whole serial-cell process samples include their containing interval but remain sampled lower bounds; startup outside the first-to-last sample span and interior sampling gaps are retained.

The combined fresh-training mode is not promoted by this diagnostic. Preserved historical measurements, reconstruction and strict-resume evidence do not establish a fresh independent-data quality result.
paired_ratio_scope: Optimized NF4 time divided by each paired reference time. Original pair-specific ratios are descriptive; placement and shared-system effects are not controlled. No pooled causal average or speed winner is inferred.
placement_scope: Anonymous host/GPU labels preserve observed identity equality. Pair1 shares host/GPU/physical and logical CPU selection. Pair2 optimized NF4 uses gpu_1 and NUMA0, while ordinary NF4 and BF16 use gpu_2 with different CPU/NUMA placement. No case is retrospectively excluded; actual memory-page placement and GPU/CPU locality were not measured.
scope: Six sequential native WTS20 execution diagnostics: two same-seed repeats each of ordinary NF4 with full projection, checkpointed-dequant NF4 with supervised projection, and dense BF16 with supervised projection. Optimized labels identify these measured configurations, not globally optimal tuning.

timing_scope.native_train_command: Includes process and model startup, initial/final validation, all20 updates, and checkpoint work.
timing_scope.training_through_scoring: Sum of train20, inspect20, publish20, score64 command walls; nested within serial_cell and not additional allocation cost.
timing_scope.update_timer: Native timer/e2e_step_s excludes initial validation and post-update boundary validation/checkpoint work; those costs are included in the native training-command wall and retained separately.
timing_scope.whole_allocation: Actual scheduler allocation elapsed time, including preflight and outside-command time; charged once.
